text:
ava_partnerships: Quick sync w/ Sundial HW team — NDA signed, they want us to validate power/thermal traces + perf deltas across quant profiles. Need a short runbook and sample logs to bootstrap. Who can own instrumentation + the first bench run?
rohit_eng: I can own the bench run. what HW image are they shipping?
ava_partnerships: It's the Sundial S1 pre-alpha units (FW 0.9). They asked for perf vs our 8-bit and 4-bit quant profiles.
marta_pm: Heads-up: marketing is gating joint announcement on "no regression" for our latency SLOs. We'll need the initial regression matrix within 48h.
samir_ops: lab access windows: Tues/Thu 10-14 PST this week. Need to provision telemetry collectors and K8s node affinity for their test harness. @rohit_eng can you confirm you can do Tue 10?
rohit_eng: Tue 10 works. I'll bring a lightweight telemetry agent and a config script.
rohit_eng: config snippet: ```bash
# deploy telemetry agent
kubectl apply -f sundial-telemetry-agent.yaml
```
jules_se: I'll coordinate NDA handoff for Sundial's firmware logs, ask legal to redact serials.
telemetry-bot: Instrumentation docs uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/telemetry/sundial - includes collectors, exporters, and example dashboards :mag:
marta_pm: After the first run, please dump the CSV with columns: model, quant, tokens/sec, p95_latency_ms, power_w. I'll own the regression table and PR to the partner.
ava_partnerships: Awesome, thanks. Action items: rohit -> bench run Tue10, samir -> infra + collectors, jules -> NDA handoff, marta -> regression report. Ping me in this thread when lab run completes. :rocket:
